title: VisualProgram
description: The whitelisted JSON DSL the codegen LLM emits for a canned question. ONE schema serves three masters (decision: dsl-json-schema-unification): (1) the Azure OpenAI structured-output constraint so codegen is valid-by-construction, (2) the FastAPI interpreter's structural validator, (3) the base shape the run-doc augments. A program is an ordered list of named steps; each step's `id` is a binding that later steps reference by name. The schema enforces STRUCTURE (whitelisted ops + arg shapes + types). SEMANTICS (a ref names a real prior step of a compatible kind, value ranges) are enforced by the interpreter — see validate_program.py. OpenAI strict note: the API call supplies {name, strict:true}; strip `$schema`/`$id`/`title` before sending (keywords OpenAI rejects at root). Everything else here is strict-compatible: object roots, additionalProperties:false, all-required, enums, $defs/$ref, anyOf.

program.description: Ordered execution steps. Step N may reference the `id` of any step < N.

binding.description: The `id` of a prior step whose output this argument consumes (a named binding). The interpreter checks the referenced step exists, precedes this one, and produces a compatible kind.

sample_frames.description: Sample frames from the clip over a time window. Output kind: frames.

start_ms.description: Window start in ms. Interpreter range: 0..clip_duration_ms.

detect.description: Run Azure AI Vision object detection per frame. Output kind: detections (boxes with class + confidence, per frame).

classes.description: Object classes to keep, e.g. ["person","ball"]. Azure tags are matched case-insensitively.

crop.description: Crop a sub-region from each detection box (the load-bearing detect->crop->read_text association chain). Output kind: crops.

region.description: Which sub-region of each box to crop. `jersey` = upper-back number region (the OCR target for read_text).

read_text.description: Run Azure AI Vision Read (OCR) on each crop. Output kind: texts (string + confidence + source box, per crop).

filter.description: Keep only items whose `field` equals `equals`. Output kind: same kind as the input items.

field.description: Field on each item, e.g. "text" or "class".

count.description: Count the items in a collection. Output kind: number.

temporal_order.description: Order events in time to reason about sequence (e.g. is this the FIRST goal). Output kind: ordered events.

by.description: Ordering key. v1 supports timestamp only.

answer.description: Produce the final evidence-grounded answer to the canned question. Output kind: answer (verdict + supporting bindings). Must be the last step.

question.description: The canned question being answered, verbatim.
